title: Identifying Inappropriate Intimacy Smell
question: Which of the following statements best describes the 'Inappropriate Intimacy' code smell?

options.text: A class refers to a class that contains only fields and crude methods for accessing them (getters and setters).
A variable, parameter, field, method or class is no longer used (usually because it’s obsolete).
One class uses the internal fields and methods of another class excessively.
There’s an unused class, method, field or parameter, created “just in case” for features that never get implemented.

explanation: 'Inappropriate Intimacy' describes a situation where one class is too coupled with the internal details (fields, methods) of another class. Good object-oriented design aims for loose coupling, where classes know as little as possible about each other's internals, making them easier to maintain and reuse.
